guardTitle: B32 Replanning / Goal Continuation / Next Decision
overrideReason: 与B27/B28相同，用户规范明确将B32核心分配给decision/+agent_。B23 guard(mindruntime/)为默认值，实际决策循环与重新规划入口位于decision层。
resolutionDetail: B32的唯一Replanning含义是'受控重新进入现有Decision主链'，不是建立Replanner2。现有架构中：(1)decision.CandidateGenerator已支持GenerateCandidatesWithExcludes用于排除重复Candidate；(2)scoring已内置RepeatPenalty/FatiguePenalty防循环；(3)fallbackCandidate(wait_observe)已在arbitration中实现；(4)mindruntime/reconciliation/reconciliation_engine.go为后续B36 Reconciliation职责，B32只读。
